EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - SYNTHETIC
Employee: Avery Example
Employer: Example Research
Start date: 2027-01-01
Monthly salary: RM6,000

PROBATION
The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date.
During probation, either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice.

CONFIRMATION
After written confirmation, either party may terminate with sixty days written notice.
Confidentiality: The employee must protect confidential information.

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - SYNTHETIC / SCHEDULE 4
Business expenses
Reimbursement requires prior written approval and itemized receipts. Claims must identify the business purpose and be submitted to the finance team. Expenses without supporting receipts may be returned for clarification.
Schedule allowance: RM140
Allowance is reimbursed only against approved receipts and is separate from monthly salary.
Records and handover
The employee and manager should keep the approved records with the agreement. No deadline beyond the text on this page is established by this schedule.
End of schedule 4.

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - SYNTHETIC / SCHEDULE 5
Company equipment
Equipment remains company property. The employee must take reasonable care of issued devices and report loss promptly. On the final working day, the employee must return issued equipment and recorded access credentials through the company handover process.
Schedule allowance: RM150
Allowance is reimbursed only against approved receipts and is separate from monthly salary.
Records and handover
The employee and manager should keep the approved records with the agreement. No deadline beyond the text on this page is established by this schedule.
End of schedule 5.

Records and handover
The employee and manager should keep the approved records with the agreement. No deadline beyond the text on this page is established by this schedule.
